profiles.biography: Lynda Eubanks is a music adjudicator, composer, and arranger who has judged Drum Corps International World Class events since 2000 (including DCI Open Class Finals three years running) along with high school marching band circuits and state finals nationwide. She earned a Bachelor of Music Education from the Baldwin-Wallace Conservatory of Music and a Master of Music in conducting from Kent State University, and operates Lynda Eubanks Music, creating and customizing marching band shows.

profiles.biography: Aaron Snipes III, a native of Americus, Georgia, is a music/general-effect adjudicator, clinician, and arranger active with Drum Corps International. A member of the Texas and Florida music educator and bandmaster associations, NAfME, and the American School Band Directors Association, he has judged internationally including the 2013 Thailand World Music Championships and the 2018 and 2019 WGI UK Winds and Percussion Regionals.

profiles.biography: Rick Rodriguez is a percussion adjudicator, clinician, and educator who holds a Bachelor of Music Education from the University of North Texas, where he was center snare of the PASIC-winning UNT drumline. He has been a percussion staff member of the Blue Devils, Phantom Regiment, Blue Knights, and the Cavaliers, and adjudicates for Drum Corps International, Bands of America, and WGI. He is the percussion director and Associate Band Director at Cedar Ridge High School in Round Rock, Texas, and is an Innovative Percussion and Marimba One artist.

profiles.biography: Jennifer 'Jen' Barton is a color guard adjudicator, choreographer, and consultant, a native of Greenwood, Indiana, who recently retired as color guard director at Rouse High School (Leander, TX) and is on the movement and visual staff of the Music City drum and bugle corps. Over a 20-year career across the Carolinas, Georgia, and Texas she has worked with scholastic and independent ensembles including Byrnes HS, Origins, The Cast, and Etude winter guards, and the Pacific Crest, Spirit of Atlanta, and Phantom Regiment drum corps. As a performer she appeared with the Santa Clara Vanguard and Northeast Independent winter guard, and she served as a Color Guard judge at the 2025 DCI World Championships.

facts.fact: Color guard choreographer; Rouse HS CG director (ret.); Music City staff; SCV alum; DCI Color Guard judge
